passages.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write this letter.
They write to the church of the Thessalonians.
This church belongs to God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy greet the Thessalonian church.
They wish grace for the Thessalonians.
They wish peace for the Thessalonians.
Grace and peace come from God our Father.
Grace and peace come from the Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

passages.text: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
passages.sermon:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the church of the Thessalonians.
They are in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy speak to the brothers in this church.
We must always thank God for you.
This is the right thing to do.
Your faith is growing very much.
Your love for one another is increasing.
passages.original: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους

passages.text: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
passages.sermon:
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy speak to the church of the Thessalonians.
They belong to God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy talk about the Thessalonians to other churches of God.
They boast about the Thessalonians.
They praise the Thessalonians for their perseverance.
They praise the Thessalonians for their faith.
The Thessalonians show perseverance and faith during persecution.
The Thessalonians endure many afflictions.
passages.original: ὥστε αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐνκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε

passages.text: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
passages.sermon:
God judges righteously.
Your endurance shows this clearly.
God’s judgment is just.
God will count you worthy of His kingdom.
You are suffering for God’s kingdom.
passages.original: Ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε

passages.text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you, and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
passages.sermon:
God is just.
God will repay those who afflict you.
God will give them affliction.
God will give relief to you who are suffering.
God will also give relief to us.
This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven.
The Lord Jesus will come with His mighty angels.
He will come in blazing fire.
The Lord Jesus will punish those who do not know God.
He will punish those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
passages.original: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ μετ’ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ἐν πυρὶ φλογός διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσιν Θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ

passages.text: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might, on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
passages.sermon:
God will judge those who do not know Him and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
These people will receive a just penalty.
They will suffer eternal destruction.
They will be separated from the presence of the Lord.
They will be cut off from the glory of His power.
This will happen on a specific day.
On that day, the Lord Jesus will come.
He will be glorified among His holy people.
He will be marveled at by all who have believed.
You are among those who have believed our testimony.
You will see His glory on that day.
passages.original: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

passages.text: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith, so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.sermon:
We always pray for you.
We pray for you because we want God to help you.
God is our God.
We ask God to count you worthy of His calling.
We ask God to fulfill every good desire you have.
We ask God to fulfill every work of faith you do.
God does this with His power.
We want the name of our Lord Jesus to be glorified in you.
We want you to be glorified in Jesus.
This happens by the grace of our God.
This happens by the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ.
passages.original: Εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
